_comment: The battle opener list (contracts §11). One entry per party member; it is credited only when
that member is the one whose command phase is up (the ACTIVE card's name).
name:   the member exactly as the game draws it, e.g. 爱丽丝
slot:   左上 | 右上 | 左下 | 右下   (the pre-assigned quick slot the cast uses)
target: enemy | party-front        (the side the skill resolves over)
Load it with WVD_BATTLE_OPENERS=default, or =<path> for another file; unset/off loads none.
Ships empty: the cast is off until the battle's action order is measured (card t-mw9jlglv-5pivpl).
